title: Kenapa Gurita Punya Tiga Jantung?
hook: Tahukah kamu, gurita itu punya TIGA jantung sekaligus? Tapi kenapa harus sebanyak itu?

scenes.narration: Tahukah kamu, gurita itu punya TIGA jantung sekaligus? Tapi kenapa harus sebanyak itu?
scenes.visual: A vibrant animated cartoon octopus swimming in a clear blue ocean scene surrounded by colorful coral reef, looking curious and expressive.
scenes.subject: An expressive cartoon octopus
scenes.environment: Vibrant underwater coral reef with sunlight rays filtering through water
scenes.focus: The octopus swimming in the center of the frame looking at the viewer
scenes.visual_relationship: The octopus interacts naturally with its underwater environment
scenes.action: The octopus swims gracefully towards the camera while waving its tentacles
scenes.emphasis: Three soft glowing heart silhouettes inside the octopus body
scenes.motion_target: The torso of the swimming octopus
scenes.caption: Tahukah kamu, gurita itu punya TIGA jantung sekaligus? Tapi kenapa harus sebanyak itu?

scenes.narration: Rahasianya ada di darah mereka yang berwarna biru. Darah ini ternyata kurang efisien membawa oksigen.
scenes.visual: A clean semi-transparent side view illustration of an octopus body showing bright glowing blue fluid flowing smoothly through simple circulatory channels.
scenes.subject: Semi-transparent body of an octopus showing blood vessels
scenes.environment: Deep blue oceanic gradient background with soft lighting
scenes.focus: The glowing cyan-blue blood flowing inside the central body
scenes.visual_relationship: Internal blue blood vessels positioned within the transparent body shell
scenes.action: Blue blood particles stream continuously along the main circulatory path
scenes.emphasis: Vibrant blue color of the copper-based hemocyanin blood
scenes.motion_target: Glowing blue blood fluid flowing through internal channels
scenes.caption: Rahasianya ada di darah mereka yang berwarna biru. Darah ini ternyata kurang efisien membawa oksigen.

scenes.narration: Dua jantung bertugas memompa darah ke insang. Sedangkan satu jantung utama memompa darah kaya oksigen ke seluruh tubuh.
scenes.visual: A stylized educational illustration of octopus anatomy showing two smaller side hearts connected to the gills and one main central heart connected to the body.
scenes.subject: Three distinct glowing organs representing the three hearts
scenes.environment: Minimalist ocean background designed for clear educational visualization
scenes.focus: The distinct rhythm between the two gill hearts and the main central heart
scenes.visual_relationship: Two smaller hearts sit directly at the gill bases while the larger main heart sits in the center torso
scenes.action: The two gill hearts pulse first pushing blood to gills, then the central heart pulses sending blood out
scenes.emphasis: The coordinated pumping sequence of the three heart organs
scenes.motion_target: The three glowing heart organs pulsing in order
scenes.caption: Dua jantung bertugas memompa darah ke insang. Sedangkan satu jantung utama memompa darah kaya oksigen ke seluruh tubuh.

scenes.narration: Uniknya lagi, saat berenang, jantung utamanya justru berhenti berdetak! Makanya gurita lebih suka merayap di dasar laut.
scenes.visual: A cartoon octopus tiring out while swimming fast, then comfortably switching to crawling smoothly along sandy seafloor using its tentacles.
scenes.subject: An octopus moving on the seabed
scenes.environment: Warm sandy ocean floor with gentle sea plants and pebbles
scenes.focus: The octopus settling down and crawling comfortably along the ocean bed
scenes.visual_relationship: Octopus touching tentacles directly onto the sandy floor surface
scenes.action: The octopus transitions from fast swimming to slow relaxed crawling on the sand
scenes.emphasis: The comfortable movement of crawling instead of exhausting swimming
scenes.motion_target: The octopus crawling happily across the sandy ocean floor
scenes.caption: Uniknya lagi, saat berenang, jantung utamanya justru berhenti berdetak! Makanya gurita lebih suka merayap di dasar laut.
